newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHELSEA'S BLEAK WINTER CONTINUES WITH 3-0 DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHELSEA'S BLEAK WINTER CONTINUES WITH 3-0 DEFEAT.

text.p: Chelsea's bleak winter continued when they lost 3-0 to Sunderland in the English premier league on Sunday.
Ruud Gullit's side fell behind after half an hour through a fluke goal, Craig Russell's hopeful shot ballooning off Michael Dewberry's backside and looping over Frode Grodas in the Chelsea goal.

Kevin Ball put Sunderland 2-0 up just after halftime, meeting a cross from Michael Gray with a thundering diving header from close range and Russell completed the Londoners' misery with a third goal after 66 minutes.
Chelsea, whose talent-laden side started the season brightly, have now gone five premier games without a win. Their last league victory was over Manchester United at Old Trafford on November 2.
The victory was Sunderland's biggest since they returned to the top flight at the end of last season.
